dashboards.title: Overview
dashboards.purpose: Open on a page: is the read path up, are the probes green, did anything trust-related fire.

panels.title: Requests per 5 minutes by Worker
panels.sql: SELECT {{bucket:300}} AS t, {{col:request_outcomes.worker}} AS worker, sum(_sample_interval) AS requests FROM {{ds:request_outcomes}} WHERE {{since}} AND {{col:request_outcomes.worker}} != '' GROUP BY t, worker ORDER BY t

panels.title: Bad share by Worker, last hour
panels.sql: SELECT {{col:request_outcomes.worker}} AS worker, sum(_sample_interval) AS requests, sumIf(_sample_interval, {{col:request_outcomes.outcome}} IN ('server_error', 'exception', 'canceled')) AS bad, sumIf(_sample_interval, {{col:request_outcomes.outcome}} IN ('server_error', 'exception', 'canceled')) / sum(_sample_interval) AS bad_share FROM {{ds:request_outcomes}} WHERE {{since}} AND {{col:request_outcomes.worker}} != '' AND {{col:request_outcomes.is_synthetic}} = 0 GROUP BY worker ORDER BY bad_share DESC

panels.title: p95 latency by Worker, last hour
panels.sql: SELECT {{col:request_outcomes.worker}} AS worker, quantileExactWeighted(0.95)({{col:request_outcomes.duration_ms}}, _sample_interval) AS p95_ms FROM {{ds:request_outcomes}} WHERE {{since}} AND {{col:request_outcomes.worker}} != '' AND {{col:request_outcomes.duration_ms}} >= 0 AND {{col:request_outcomes.is_synthetic}} = 0 GROUP BY worker ORDER BY p95_ms DESC

panels.title: Probe summary passes and fails, last 6 hours
panels.note: Summary rows only; the probed version is in the attributes, so failures by target are in the Release dashboard.
panels.sql: SELECT sumIf(_sample_interval, {{col:synthetic_probes.attrs}} LIKE '%"ok":true%') AS passed, sumIf(_sample_interval, {{col:synthetic_probes.attrs}} LIKE '%"ok":false%') AS failed FROM {{ds:synthetic_probes}} WHERE {{since}} AND index1 = 'synthetic.probe' AND {{col:synthetic_probes.attrs}} LIKE '%"scenario":"summary"%'

panels.title: Probe summary rows per 5 minutes
panels.sql: SELECT {{bucket:300}} AS t, sumIf(_sample_interval, {{col:synthetic_probes.attrs}} LIKE '%"ok":true%') AS passed, sumIf(_sample_interval, {{col:synthetic_probes.attrs}} LIKE '%"ok":false%') AS failed FROM {{ds:synthetic_probes}} WHERE {{since}} AND index1 = 'synthetic.probe' AND {{col:synthetic_probes.attrs}} LIKE '%"scenario":"summary"%' GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

panels.title: Trust and pipeline signals, last 24 hours
panels.sql: SELECT index1 AS signal, sum(_sample_interval) AS n FROM {{ds:domain_events}} WHERE {{since}} AND index1 IN ('download.hash_mismatch', 'download.hash_mismatch_reported', 'index.verify_failed', 'index.key_changed', 'index.stale', 'audit.chain_broken', 'publish.failed', 'queue.dlq', 'search.degraded') GROUP BY signal ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Judge heartbeats per hour
panels.sql: SELECT {{bucket:3600}} AS t, sum(_sample_interval) AS heartbeats FROM {{ds:domain_events}} WHERE {{since}} AND index1 = 'monitoring.heartbeat' GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

dashboards.title: Release
dashboards.purpose: Two versions side by side, every gate's history, exceptions and self-test results.

panels.title: Latest verdict per version and gate, last 6 hours
panels.sql: SELECT index1 AS version_id, {{col:gate_results.gate}} AS gate, argMax({{col:gate_results.status}}, {{col:gate_results.decided_at}}) AS status, argMax({{col:gate_results.samples}}, {{col:gate_results.decided_at}}) AS samples, argMax({{col:gate_results.floor}}, {{col:gate_results.decided_at}}) AS floor, argMax({{col:gate_results.observed}}, {{col:gate_results.decided_at}}) AS observed, argMax({{col:gate_results.threshold}}, {{col:gate_results.decided_at}}) AS threshold FROM {{ds:gate_results}} WHERE {{since}} GROUP BY version_id, gate ORDER BY version_id, gate LIMIT 1000

panels.title: Gate verdicts per version, per 10 minutes
panels.sql: SELECT {{bucket:600}} AS t, index1 AS version_id, {{col:gate_results.status}} AS status, sum(_sample_interval) AS evaluations FROM {{ds:gate_results}} WHERE {{since}} GROUP BY t, version_id, status ORDER BY t LIMIT 5000

panels.title: Bad share by version, real traffic
panels.sql: SELECT index1 AS version_id, {{col:request_outcomes.worker}} AS worker, sum(_sample_interval) AS requests, sumIf(_sample_interval, {{col:request_outcomes.outcome}} IN ('server_error', 'exception', 'canceled')) AS bad, sumIf(_sample_interval, {{col:request_outcomes.outcome}} IN ('server_error', 'exception', 'canceled')) / sum(_sample_interval) AS bad_share FROM {{ds:request_outcomes}} WHERE {{since}} AND {{col:request_outcomes.worker}} != '' AND {{col:request_outcomes.version_override}} = 0 AND {{col:request_outcomes.is_synthetic}} = 0 GROUP BY version_id, worker ORDER BY worker, requests DESC

panels.title: p95 and p99 latency by version, real traffic
panels.sql: SELECT index1 AS version_id, {{col:request_outcomes.worker}} AS worker, quantileExactWeighted(0.95)({{col:request_outcomes.duration_ms}}, _sample_interval) AS p95_ms, quantileExactWeighted(0.99)({{col:request_outcomes.duration_ms}}, _sample_interval) AS p99_ms FROM {{ds:request_outcomes}} WHERE {{since}} AND {{col:request_outcomes.worker}} != '' AND {{col:request_outcomes.duration_ms}} >= 0 AND {{col:request_outcomes.version_override}} = 0 AND {{col:request_outcomes.is_synthetic}} = 0 GROUP BY version_id, worker ORDER BY worker

panels.title: Exceptions and cancellations by version
panels.sql: SELECT index1 AS version_id, {{col:request_outcomes.worker}} AS worker, {{col:request_outcomes.outcome}} AS outcome, {{col:request_outcomes.error_code}} AS error_code, sum(_sample_interval) AS n FROM {{ds:request_outcomes}} WHERE {{since}} AND {{col:request_outcomes.outcome}} IN ('exception', 'canceled') GROUP BY version_id, worker, outcome, error_code ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Self-test results by version
panels.sql: SELECT {{col:domain_events.version_id}} AS version_id, {{col:domain_events.worker}} AS worker, sumIf(_sample_interval, {{col:domain_events.attrs}} LIKE '%"ok":true%') AS passed, sumIf(_sample_interval, {{col:domain_events.attrs}} LIKE '%"ok":false%') AS failed, toUnixTimestamp(max(timestamp)) AS last_at FROM {{ds:domain_events}} WHERE {{since}} AND index1 = 'selftest.result' GROUP BY version_id, worker ORDER BY last_at DESC
panels.note: Empty until the validator or judge emits selftest.result.

panels.title: Probe summary rows, last 6 hours
panels.note: Failed summary rows with their attributes (target version, failed scenarios, index freshness).
panels.sql: SELECT {{col:synthetic_probes.attrs}} AS attrs, sum(_sample_interval) AS n, toUnixTimestamp(max(timestamp)) AS last_at FROM {{ds:synthetic_probes}} WHERE {{since}} AND index1 = 'synthetic.probe' AND {{col:synthetic_probes.attrs}} LIKE '%"scenario":"summary"%' AND {{col:synthetic_probes.attrs}} LIKE '%"ok":false%' GROUP BY attrs ORDER BY last_at DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Version-override traffic by version
panels.sql: SELECT index1 AS version_id, {{col:request_outcomes.worker}} AS worker, sum(_sample_interval) AS requests FROM {{ds:request_outcomes}} WHERE {{since}} AND {{col:request_outcomes.version_override}} = 1 GROUP BY version_id, worker ORDER BY requests DESC

dashboards.title: Publish pipeline
dashboards.purpose: From a publish arriving to a verdict: volumes, failures, validation timing, queues.

panels.title: Publish signals per hour
panels.sql: SELECT {{bucket:3600}} AS t, index1 AS signal, sum(_sample_interval) AS n FROM {{ds:domain_events}} WHERE {{since}} AND index1 IN ('publish.received', 'publish.validated', 'publish.staged_waiting', 'publish.approved', 'publish.promoted', 'publish.failed', 'publish.quota_hit') GROUP BY t, signal ORDER BY t

panels.title: Publish identity outcomes
panels.sql: SELECT index1 AS signal, sum(_sample_interval) AS n FROM {{ds:domain_events}} WHERE {{since}} AND index1 IN ('publish.oidc_exchanged', 'publish.oidc_rejected', 'publish.provenance_mismatch', 'publish.source_unverified') GROUP BY signal ORDER BY n DESC

panels.title: Publish size
panels.sql: SELECT sum(_sample_interval) AS publishes, quantileExactWeighted(0.95)({{num:publish.received.bytes}}, _sample_interval) AS p95_bytes, max({{num:publish.received.bytes}}) AS max_bytes FROM {{ds:domain_events}} WHERE {{since}} AND index1 = 'publish.received' AND {{num:publish.received.bytes}} >= 0

panels.title: Validation step duration by step
panels.sql: SELECT {{stat:validation.step.step}} AS step, sum(_sample_interval) AS runs, quantileExactWeighted(0.95)({{stat:validation.step.duration_ms}}, _sample_interval) AS p95_ms FROM {{ds:validation_events}} WHERE {{since}} AND index1 = 'validation.step' AND {{stat:validation.step.outcome}} IN ('ok', 'fail') GROUP BY step ORDER BY p95_ms DESC
panels.note: Extraction refusals are points with the refusal reason as outcome and no duration, so they are excluded here.

panels.title: Validation signals
panels.sql: SELECT index1 AS signal, sum(_sample_interval) AS n FROM {{ds:validation_events}} WHERE {{since}} AND index1 IN ('validation.step', 'validation.sandbox_timeout', 'validation.tree_hash_mismatch', 'validation.prose_screen', 'validation.verdict_distribution') GROUP BY signal ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Rescans and Workflow instances
panels.sql: SELECT index1 AS signal, sum(_sample_interval) AS n FROM {{ds:domain_events}} WHERE {{since}} AND index1 IN ('rescan.completed', 'workflow.instance_finished', 'workflow.wait_rearmed', 'rollup.completed') GROUP BY signal ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Queue depth and oldest message
panels.sql: SELECT max({{num:queue.backlog.depth}}) AS max_depth, max({{num:queue.backlog.oldest_age_s}}) AS max_oldest_age_s, argMax({{num:queue.backlog.depth}}, timestamp) AS latest_depth, argMax({{num:queue.backlog.oldest_age_s}}, timestamp) AS latest_oldest_age_s, argMax({{col:domain_events.attrs}}, timestamp) AS latest_attrs, toUnixTimestamp(max(timestamp)) AS last_at FROM {{ds:domain_events}} WHERE {{since}} AND index1 = 'queue.backlog'
panels.note: Empty until the judge emits queue.backlog. All queues are combined: the attributes hold the readings, so grouping by them would give one row per reading; a per-queue split needs the queue name in a blob.

panels.title: Dead letters and failed messages
panels.sql: SELECT index1 AS signal, sum(_sample_interval) AS n FROM {{ds:domain_events}} WHERE {{since}} AND index1 IN ('queue.dlq') GROUP BY signal ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 100

dashboards.title: Trust and abuse
dashboards.purpose: Integrity failures (expected zero), abuse pressure, moderation and account events.

panels.title: Download and index integrity, last 7 days
panels.note: Every row here other than entry_skipped is expected to be absent.
panels.sql: SELECT index1 AS signal, sum(_sample_interval) AS n FROM {{ds:domain_events}} WHERE {{since}} AND index1 IN ('download.hash_mismatch', 'download.hash_mismatch_reported', 'index.verify_failed', 'index.verify_failed_reported', 'index.key_changed', 'index.stale', 'index.stale_reported', 'index.rollback_reported', 'index.entry_skipped') GROUP BY signal ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Audit chain
panels.sql: SELECT index1 AS signal, sum(_sample_interval) AS n FROM {{ds:domain_events}} WHERE {{since}} AND index1 IN ('audit.chain_broken', 'audit.chain_verified', 'audit.head_rebuilt', 'audit.reconcile_skipped') GROUP BY signal ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Abuse signals
panels.sql: SELECT index1 AS signal, sum(_sample_interval) AS n FROM {{ds:domain_events}} WHERE {{since}} AND index1 IN ('abuse.rate_limited', 'abuse.turnstile_failed', 'abuse.anomaly_hold', 'abuse.daily_cap_hit', 'auth.login_failed_burst', 'token.rejected', 'token.leak_reported') GROUP BY signal ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Rate limiting and failed logins per hour
panels.sql: SELECT {{bucket:3600}} AS t, index1 AS signal, sum(_sample_interval) AS n FROM {{ds:domain_events}} WHERE {{since}} AND index1 IN ('abuse.rate_limited', 'abuse.turnstile_failed', 'auth.login_failed_burst') GROUP BY t, signal ORDER BY t

panels.title: Moderation
panels.sql: SELECT index1 AS signal, sum(_sample_interval) AS n FROM {{ds:domain_events}} WHERE {{since}} AND index1 IN ('moderation.report_received', 'moderation.report_prioritised', 'moderation.quarantined', 'moderation.takedown_completed') GROUP BY signal ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Oldest moderation queue entry, latest
panels.sql: SELECT argMax({{num:moderation.queue_age.age_s}}, timestamp) AS age_s, toUnixTimestamp(max(timestamp)) AS last_at FROM {{ds:domain_events}} WHERE {{since}} AND index1 = 'moderation.queue_age'

panels.title: Accounts, scopes and admin actions
panels.sql: SELECT index1 AS signal, sum(_sample_interval) AS n FROM {{ds:domain_events}} WHERE {{since}} AND index1 IN ('auth.login', 'auth.stepup', 'auth.factor_changed', 'auth.recovery_requested', 'auth.session_revoked', 'token.minted', 'token.revoked', 'scope.created', 'scope.proof_changed', 'scope.application_decided', 'grant.changed', 'admin.action', 'cloudflare.audit_event') GROUP BY signal ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Refused requests by country
panels.sql: SELECT {{col:request_outcomes.country}} AS country, {{col:request_outcomes.outcome}} AS outcome, sum(_sample_interval) AS n FROM {{ds:request_outcomes}} WHERE {{since}} AND {{col:request_outcomes.outcome}} = 'refused' GROUP BY country, outcome ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 50

dashboards.title: Platform and cost
dashboards.purpose: Where the account's meters stand: traffic, CPU and binding time, third-party limits, spend counters.

panels.title: CPU and binding time by Worker, p95
panels.note: -1 marks an unknown measurement and is excluded for CPU only; the binding columns use the same -1 for not used, so read them as a floor.
panels.sql: SELECT {{col:request_outcomes.worker}} AS worker, quantileExactWeighted(0.95)({{col:request_outcomes.cpu_ms}}, _sample_interval) AS cpu_p95, quantileExactWeighted(0.95)({{col:request_outcomes.d1_ms}}, _sample_interval) AS d1_p95, quantileExactWeighted(0.95)({{col:request_outcomes.r2_ms}}, _sample_interval) AS r2_p95, quantileExactWeighted(0.95)({{col:request_outcomes.kv_ms}}, _sample_interval) AS kv_p95, quantileExactWeighted(0.95)({{col:request_outcomes.vectorize_ms}}, _sample_interval) AS vectorize_p95 FROM {{ds:request_outcomes}} WHERE {{since}} AND {{col:request_outcomes.worker}} != '' AND {{col:request_outcomes.cpu_ms}} >= 0 GROUP BY worker

panels.title: Requests per day by Worker
panels.sql: SELECT {{bucket:86400}} AS t, {{col:request_outcomes.worker}} AS worker, sum(_sample_interval) AS requests FROM {{ds:request_outcomes}} WHERE {{since}} AND {{col:request_outcomes.worker}} != '' GROUP BY t, worker ORDER BY t

panels.title: Cache status share, last day
panels.sql: SELECT {{col:request_outcomes.cache_status}} AS cache_status, sum(_sample_interval) AS requests FROM {{ds:request_outcomes}} WHERE {{since}} AND {{col:request_outcomes.cache_status}} != '' GROUP BY cache_status ORDER BY requests DESC

panels.title: Private download volume per day
panels.sql: SELECT {{bucket:86400}} AS t, sum(_sample_interval) AS downloads, sumIf({{col:downloads.bytes}} * _sample_interval, {{col:downloads.bytes}} >= 0) AS bytes FROM {{ds:downloads}} WHERE {{since}} GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
panels.note: bytes counts only downloads whose size is known.

panels.title: Budget usage, latest per meter
panels.note: Nothing writes budget.usage yet; the panel is empty until the judge's budget computation lands.
panels.sql: SELECT {{col:budget.attrs}} AS attrs, toUnixTimestamp(max(timestamp)) AS last_at, sum(_sample_interval) AS points FROM {{ds:budget}} WHERE {{since}} AND index1 = 'budget.usage' GROUP BY attrs ORDER BY last_at DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: GitHub rate limit and email failures
panels.note: min_remaining is meaningful only on the github.rate_limit_remaining row.
panels.sql: SELECT index1 AS signal, sum(_sample_interval) AS n, min({{num:github.rate_limit_remaining.remaining}}) AS min_remaining FROM {{ds:domain_events}} WHERE {{since}} AND index1 IN ('github.rate_limit_remaining', 'github.webhook_rejected', 'github.scan_run', 'email.sent', 'email.failed', 'search.vectorize_error', 'search.degraded') GROUP BY signal

panels.title: Prose screen runs and duration by implementation
panels.note: Model spend is not recorded: a prose screen point carries its implementation and duration only, so this shows how often the screen runs, not what it costs.
panels.sql: SELECT {{stat:validation.prose_screen.implementation}} AS implementation, sum(_sample_interval) AS runs, quantileExactWeighted(0.95)({{stat:validation.prose_screen.duration_ms}}, _sample_interval) AS p95_ms FROM {{ds:validation_events}} WHERE {{since}} AND index1 = 'validation.prose_screen' GROUP BY implementation ORDER BY runs DESC
